purpose: Experimental optional-backend comparison; not completion-score evidence
source_note: Rebased branch at source_commit plus the Basin 1.10.0 manifest and lockfile update; exact measured files are identified by source_sha256.

methodology.deviance_counts: Separate instrumented prepared fits; includes post-fit evaluation. Unweighted LMM cases only.
methodology.limitation: Affinity-controlled local measurements still show variation on unchanged scalar searches. Small timing differences do not establish optimizer overhead or a general performance ranking.
methodology.cpu_affinity_description: One logical CPU from each of the two physical performance cores; taskset --cpu-list 0,2 for both backends.

validation.numerical_repeatability: Identical theta, coefficients, objectives, and iteration counts across the four processes for each backend and case; all report convergence.
validation.objective_consistency: Optimizer and final evaluated objectives agree in all twelve cases within relative tolerance 1e-10 or absolute tolerance 1e-7.
validation.release_golden_parity: passed with both backends (two tests each)
validation.preflight: passed; optional repository-admin token verification skipped because token is unset
validation.basin_check: passed: feature-enabled Clippy, all-target compilation, full tests, and documentation generation
commands: nix shell nixpkgs#cargo-audit -c python3 scripts/ci/lme_ci.py preflight
validation.documentation_check: passed: local links, dashboard JSON drift, Rust examples, doctests, and generated documentation

methodology.description: Shared CSV fixtures; data loaded once; model fit timed per metric; Julia JIT warmed up.
methodology.note: Different optimizers and likelihood paths; compare throughput, not coefficient identity.
